sprint.name: State Synchronization & Reliability
sprint.goal: Improve state management reliability and prevent position tracking bugs

completed.title: BLUR Position State Corruption Fix
completed.description: Fixed state sync bug where averaging_steps persisted across position cycles
changes: Added startup validation for stale averaging_steps (line 655-685)
Manually closed stuck BLUR position ($2.60 profit realized)

backlog.title: Position Timestamp Tracking
backlog.description: Add position_opened_timestamp to detect stale state more reliably
acceptance_criteria: Track timestamp when position is opened on exchange
On startup, compare stored timestamp with exchange position data
Reset derived state if timestamps don't match
Log warnings for detected stale states

backlog.title: Automated Stuck Position Alerts
backlog.description: Implement alerts for positions stuck in profit-taking zones
acceptance_criteria: Detect positions in SURPLUS_DUMP zone for >4 hours with no action
Alert via Telegram when surplus dump blocked by minimum threshold
Include position details and recommended actions in alert
Auto-suggest manual close if surplus is too small

backlog.title: Zone Transition Logging & Monitoring
backlog.description: Add comprehensive logging for zone transitions to track performance
acceptance_criteria: Log all zone transitions with timestamp and trigger reason
Track time spent in each zone per position
Expose metrics for monitoring dashboard
Alert on unusual patterns (e.g., rapid zone cycling)

backlog.title: Extend Startup Validation to All Critical State
backlog.description: Extend stale state detection to other critical variables
acceptance_criteria: Validate original_sizes consistency with position margin
Validate peak_upnl is reasonable given current P&L
Validate surplus_dump_stage matches position state
Add cross-validation between Redis db=0 and db=1

backlog.title: State Synchronization Stress Testing
backlog.description: Stress test state sync under various failure scenarios
acceptance_criteria: Test concurrent updates to both Redis databases
Test network failures during cleanup process
Test system restart during position operations
Document recovery procedures for each failure mode

backlog.title: Redis Connection Pooling Health Checks
backlog.description: Add health checks to grok_v2_redis_pool for early failure detection
acceptance_criteria: Implement connection health pings every 30s
Auto-reconnect on connection failure
Alert on persistent connection issues
Add connection pool metrics to monitoring
